purchase_objections: Does it edit my real .xlsx/.pptx without breaking formulas, linked charts and corporate templates? The film never shows the formatting it claimed chatbots wreck being preserved.
'Cloud AI may process document content.' (f_42) - board/client material leaving the device is a compliance stop for my firm; no word on data handling, retention or deployment.
The hero is 'Accept all' (f_39) - that is what I do when I don't check; it weakens 'This time, you checked.'
Team feature is a 'DEMO SESSION, SIMULATED TEAMMATE' (f_29) - reads as not real yet.
Composite glitches look staged: memo floats off the laptop screen with an empty grey band and a haloed finger (f_33-f_34); blank white screen at the Send click (f_44).
'Request early access' with no price, platform or integration (Office/SharePoint) info.
'Can make mistakes' status - I still need proof it finds every place the number lives (it found slide 7 too, good, but how do I know it found all?).
would_try: maybe - the slide-4-reverted pain is exactly my 8:55 AM, and the per-element diff list (Slide 2 TextBox 23, Slide 4 title, chart data) is credible, but cloud processing of board docs needs IT sign-off first.
buy_decision: TRY_FIRST - flips to BUY if it shows my own template-heavy deck and model edited with formatting intact and a clear statement of where document content is processed (e.g. enterprise/private model option).
